note: A recorded decision script for the deterministic provider (spec §87).
Turn 5 is deliberately the same push as turn 4. When the runtime parks the
run in WAITING it has not executed anything: on resume the agent is asked
for its next action, re-issues the push, and the executor finds the approval
a human already made - matched by the action's fingerprint, not by its id
(spec §23, §32). Two modes, one script: `finish` has the closing turn for
each decision, and both are consumed at the same position.
The first turn is a planner answer only when planning is enabled; this agent
turns planning off, so every turn here is a decision.
